GET_DMP_Command_Configuration.description: Loads active Agent 4 status configuration items.

SET_AlertMailSubject_(ConfigLoadFailed).description: Builds the subject of the config-load-failed alert mail so it can later be reused for the Sent Items lookup and move operation. Uses hardcoded fallback values throughout this branch since the central configuration itself could not be loaded.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Agent 4 - Status Check failed.


The central DMP COMMAND configuration list could not be loaded, so no status data could be checked or returned.


Run ID: @{workflow()?['run']?['name']}

Please check SharePoint list availability and permissions.

MAIL_Alert_(ConfigLoadFailed).description: Sends an alert mail when the central configuration fails to load, using hardcoded fallback values since CMP_ConfigObject is not available in this branch.

Delay_Before_Get_Sent_Email_(ConfigLoadF.description: Waits before searching Sent Items so that the alert mail can be indexed and found reliably.

Get_Sent_Email_By_Subject_(ConfigLoadFai.description: Searches Sent Items for the Agent 4 config-load-failed alert mail using the exact subject stored in AlertMailSubject.

SET_AlertMessageId__(ConfigLoadFailed).description: Stores the message id of the sent config-load-failed alert mail so it can be moved to the Agent 4 Alerts folder.

Get_Alert_Folder_ID_(ConfigLoadFailed).description: Resolves the Agent 4 Alerts mailbox folder ID directly by display name (config not available in this branch, so the folder must already exist from a prior successful run).

Move_Email_(ConfigLoadFailed).description: Moves the Agent 4 alert mail from Sent Items to the Agent 4 Alerts folder.

FILTER_Config_CurrentOperationMode.description: Finds current DMP COMMAND operation mode.

Select_ConfigEntries.description: Maps each configuration row to a mode-resolved JSON key-value fragment, replacing the slow per-row loop with a single non-looping data operation.

CMP_ConfigJsonText.description: Completes the configuration JSON text by wrapping all resolved property fragments in braces.

CMP_ConfigObject.description: Converts the generated configuration JSON text into the central configuration object for this run.

SCOPE_NextMilestones_Read.description: Reads the real-world Default Management Process milestones from 'Status DMP Process.xlsx' (Overall Process sheet) and picks the next few not-yet-done ones for the Cockpit's Next Steps card.

GET_OverallProcess_Rows.description: Lists all rows of the OverallProcess table (Phase, ID, Milestone, Responsibility, Status) from the real-world DMP process tracker.

SET_LastSeenPhase_IfPresent.description: Carries the last non-blank Phase value forward onto the following rows that belong to the same merged Phase group.

APPEND_NextMilestone.description: Adds this pending milestone to the Next Steps buffer, stopping once 5 have been collected.

IF_StatusNotDoneAndRoomLeft.description: Collects this row as one of the next pending milestones if its Status is not 'done' and fewer than 5 have been collected so far.

LOOP_OverallProcessRows.description: Walks every Overall Process row in sheet order, forward-filling the Phase and collecting the next pending (not 'done') milestones.

VAR_ConfigObject.description: Stores resolved status configuration values, built via Select+Join instead of a per-row loop.

SCOPE_PowerAppVersion_Read.description: Reads the Power App version text file so the Cockpit header can display the current version without requiring a Power-Fx/Studio edit for every version bump.

GET_PowerAppVersion_Content.description: Reads the Power App version text file maintained outside of Power Apps Studio.

SET_PowerAppVersionText.description: Stores the trimmed Power App version text for inclusion in the status response. Keeps the initialized fallback default if the file read failed.

SCOPE_AuditSummary_Read.description: Reads the Agent Audit Summary table for all 5 agents and aggregates Failed/Warning step counts and total run counts for the Control Board.

GET_AuditSummary_Agent01.description: Reads Agent 1's row from Agent Audit Summary for aggregation.

GET_AuditSummary_Agent02.description: Reads Agent 2's row from Agent Audit Summary for aggregation.

GET_AuditSummary_Agent03.description: Reads Agent 3's row from Agent Audit Summary for aggregation.

GET_AuditSummary_Agent04.description: Reads Agent 4's own row from Agent Audit Summary for aggregation.

GET_AuditSummary_Agent05.description: Reads Agent 5's row from Agent Audit Summary for aggregation.

GET_AuditSummary_Agent06.description: Reads Agent 6's row from Agent Audit Summary for aggregation. Tolerated as Failed downstream so a not-yet-seeded row never blocks the whole status check.

SET_AggregatedFailedStepsCount.description: Sums the FailedStepsCount column across all 6 agent rows in Agent Audit Summary.

SET_AggregatedWarningStepsCount.description: Sums the WarningStepsCount column across all 6 agent rows in Agent Audit Summary.

SET_Agent6Healthy.description: Marks Agent 6 as healthy when it has no recorded failed runs in Agent Audit Summary, consistent with how the other 5 agents' health is derived.

CMP_TotalRunsPerAgent.description: Computes each agent's total run count (Succeeded+Failed+Warning+Started) as an array, one element per agent, for all 6 agents.

SET_AggregatedRunSummaryCount.description: Sums the per-agent total run counts into the system-wide AuditRunSummaryCount shown on the Control Board.

Get_DMP_Mailbox_Parent_Folder_ID.description: Resolves the mailbox folder ID of the processed-mails root folder so that the Agent 4 alerts subfolder can later be created and addressed.

Create_Mailbox_Subfolder_\"PA_Processed_.description: Creates the processed-mails root folder in the shared mailbox if it does not yet exist.

Create_Mailbox_Subfolder_\"Agent_4_Alert.description: Creates the dedicated Agent 4 Alerts mailbox subfolder below the processed-mails root folder if it does not yet exist.

Get_DMP_Mailbox_Subfolder_ID_for_\"Agent.description: Resolves the mailbox folder ID of the Agent 4 Alerts mailbox subfolder so that sent internal Agent 4 alert mails can later be moved there.

SET_AlertTargetFolderId.description: Stores the mailbox folder ID of the Agent 4 Alerts folder for moving sent alert mails.

E-Mail_Folder_creation.description: Ensures the Agent 4 Alerts mailbox evidence folder exists and resolves its folder id.
